series_description: Individual District × Disease Weekly Outbreak Series (34 districts × 28 diseases)
scientific_rationale: 71.43% zero-death weeks and at most 28 active outbreak weeks out of 156 calendar weeks per district-disease pair; time-series forecasting at this grain would overfit noise.

series_description: District-Level Weekly All-Disease Mortality Series (34 active districts)
scientific_rationale: Median district has only 12 active outbreak weeks and 2 total deaths across 2023-2025; descriptive trend + Empirical Bayes CFR with Wilson 95% CI is scientifically appropriate.

series_description: Statewide Weekly Mortality for Malaria (32 wks) & Acute Diarrhoeal Disease (69 wks, 11 death wks)
scientific_rationale: Fewer than 50 active weekly time points with non-zero mortality; insufficient sample size for 70/15/15 chronological train/validation/test forecasting splits.

series_description: Statewide Weekly Dengue Outbreak Mortality Series (2023-2025)
scientific_rationale: 82 active surveillance weeks with 53 positive-death weeks (82 total deaths) support chronological 70/15/15 validation against naive and rolling baselines.

series_description: Statewide Weekly Aggregate Outbreak Mortality Series (All Diseases 2023-2025)
scientific_rationale: 121 active surveillance weeks with 71 positive-death weeks (199 total deaths) provide the highest-density mortality time series in the workspace for chronological evaluation.
